# Alternations

Prefer LaTeX

```{code-cell}
display({
    "text/plain": "I'm a string!",
    "text/latex": "I'm a $x + y$ eqn"
}, raw=True)
```

Prefer Image over LaTeX

```{code-cell}
svg_data = ""
display({
    "text/latex": "I'm a $x + y$ eqn",
    "image/svg+xml": svg_data
}, raw=True)
```

Prefer Markdown over image

```{code-cell}
display({
    "text/markdown": "I'm a *string*!",
    "image/svg+xml": svg_data
}, raw=True)
```

Prefer Markdown over LaTeX

```{code-cell}
display({
    "text/markdown": "I'm a *string*!",
    "text/latex": "I'm a $x + y$ eqn",
}, raw=True)
```
